title: Provident Bank Celebrates 70 Years of Community Impact with Over $984,000 Donated to Local Nonprofits Since 2006 Through Its Community Partnership Program
summary: RIVERSIDE, Calif., April 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Provident Financial Holdings, Inc., NASDAQ GS: PROV, the holding company for Provident Savings Bank, F.S.B. (“Provident Bank”), proudly celebrates 70 years of serving the Riverside and San Bernardino County communities – and giving back has never been more meaningful. In 2025 alone, the Bank donated over $38,000 to local nonprofit organizations through its Community Partnership Program.
